(3) The camera pans down to multiple woven baskets filled with rows of charred, dark animals neatly arranged. A pair of hands reaches into one basket to adjust the items. A woman wearing a patterned pink dress stands behind the table, surrounded by a crowd of curious onlookers in various casual clothing. A crowd of local children and adults stands behind him, some smiling and observing his reaction. He ends by making a 'crossing arms' gesture. (6) A final montage repeats close-up shots of the grilled animals in baskets. The lighting remains bright and consistent with the previous outdoor market scenes.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce and document a unique local culinary delicacy (grilled mice) in Mozambique. The creator uses a vlog-style narrative to engage the audience with a 'guess what this is' hook, provides local context and pricing, and then shares a first-hand, authentic reaction to the taste to satisfy viewers' curiosity about exotic food cultures.
